hook.name: PadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad token launchpad. Collects a platform fee on every swap, splitting it between the token creator and treasury; a configurable portion is auto-routed to a buyback-and-burn. Applies a block-decaying anti-snipe surcharge on early buys and a time-decaying surcharge on sells by the original token deployer.
